description: Find and replace using a regex pattern. Supports capture group references ($1, $2, $&, etc.) in the replacement string.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to match

replacement.description: The replacement string. Use $1, $2 for captured groups, $& for full match, $` for text before match, $' for text after match

text.description: The input text to perform replacements on

name: regex_replace
